claim: Provider-neutral presence is bounded, ephemeral, identity-aware, and cleans up disconnected peers without misrepresenting Drive polling as live presence.
verified: Awareness projection accepts only bounded schema-versioned participant metadata and omits selection/cursor payloads
The Memory provider exchanges live awareness updates between two clients
Disconnect publishes a removal before leaving the hub so connected peers clean up immediately
Reconnect exchanges awareness tombstones so a partitioned peer cannot resurrect stale presence
Identity-safe provider registration prevents an old lifecycle cleanup from removing a newer provider
Lexical awareness uses the installation researcher ID and current display name rather than a fixed placeholder
The product surface distinguishes local-only, Drive-polling, and future live transport modes
Drive copy explicitly says that polling does not provide live cursors or online status
Malformed or excess peer awareness is hidden behind a visible accessible warning
MCP research inspection returns only transport mode and bounded session/integrity counts
Production TypeScript and Vite build passes
limitations: Memory is the only live awareness transport in this slice; installed local and Drive providers do not exchange remote presence.
Drive polling synchronizes Yjs edits but intentionally does not claim live cursors or online status.
Collaborator identity is self-reported and is not authenticated.
No self-hosted WebSocket provider, packaged physical two-client proof, or five-client soak is included yet.
